subject: PR guidance + marketplace options (Coupa/Ariba) — next steps

Subject: PR guidance + marketplace options (Coupa/Ariba) — next steps

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the procurement/commercial path so your legal/procurement team has what they need:

1) Procurement readiness:
- You confirmed intent to purchase, but team prefers to route via a Purchase Requisition (PR) first (standard for IT purchases).
- Two possible payment paths: PO (net 30) or corporate card for faster activation.

2) Marketplace vs paper agreement:
- You asked about AWS Marketplace — we support both Marketplace listings and direct procurement. Marketplace shortens procurement (no separate contract), but invoice/usage flows through AWS.
- If you prefer direct (paper) purchase, procurement will need our Supplier ID and standard SOW/quote.

3) Coupa/Ariba supplier linkage & PR creation guidance (attached):
- Use the attached 'PR_Template.xlsx' and 'Supplier_Setup_Instructions.pdf' for the fields procurement typically needs. Key items: Redwood Supplier Name: Redwood Inference, Tax ID: 12-3456789, Payee Address: 123 Mission St, San Francisco, CA.
- If using Coupa/Ariba: ask procurement to search for supplier name AND provide our Redwood Supplier ID (we'll verify and create vendor record if missing).

Next steps:
- If you want us to initiate supplier setup, please confirm the contact at Acme who will own the Coupa/Ariba ticket. We can also open an internal ops ticket to coordinate with finance.
- If Marketplace is preferred, let us know and we will share the AWS Marketplace listing and enable procurement flow; turnaround tends to be faster.

Attaching the template and supplier instructions. Happy to hop on a 15-min call with your procurement if needed — propose Wed 10am PT?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: PR_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet), Supplier_Setup_Instructions.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: PR guidance + marketplace options (Coupa/Ariba) — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear note and attachments. A few clarifications from procurement:

- We prefer to go through our Coupa flow and raise a PR. Procurement needs: Redwood Supplier ID (if you have one), W-9, and a quote line itemized by monthly committed capacity vs burst.
- Card payment is possible for initial pilot (up to $5k), but leadership wants PO for production.
- Marketplace is an option but requires legal sign-off on the subscription model; tends to be slower for enterprise terms.

Can you confirm Redwood Supplier ID? If you don't have one, pls initiate supplier setup with our P2P team and cc procurement@acme-analytics.com. Also, can someone from Redwood join a short call Thursday at 11am ET to run procurement through the Coupa fields?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Cloud Platforms | Acme Analytics
alex.turner@acme-analytics.com
